description: Fetch full metadata for a specific jurisdiction including all legislative sessions, their identifiers, and coverage dates. Use when you need to know the exact session identifier for a state before filtering bill searches — session formats vary widely (e.g., "2025", "2025rs", "2025s1"). Jurisdiction IDs follow OCD format: ocd-jurisdiction/country:us/state:{abbr}/government (e.g., ocd-jurisdiction/country:us/state:wa/government). State names (e.g., "Washington") and two-letter abbreviations (e.g., "wa") are also accepted.

include.description: Related data to inline. "legislative_sessions" returns all historical and current sessions with identifiers and date ranges. "organizations" lists the jurisdiction's legislative chambers and executive bodies. "latest_runs" shows last scraper run metadata.

jurisdiction_id.description: OCD jurisdiction ID, state name (e.g., "Washington"), or two-letter abbreviation (e.g., "wa").

name: openstates_get_jurisdiction

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: Jurisdiction ID does not exist in Open States. `upstream_timeout`: Open States did not answer within the per-request timeout. `rate_limited`: The shared Open States API key reached a request cap — Open States' per-minute or daily limit, or this server's own daily budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

latest_bill_update.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent bill data update.

latest_people_update.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent people data update.

latest_runs.description: Recent scraper runs when include=latest_runs is requested.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run finished. Absent when unrecorded.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the scraper run started.

success.description: Whether the run succeeded. Absent when not recorded.

legislative_sessions.description: All legislative sessions when include=legislative_sessions is requested.

classification.description: Session classification: "primary", "special", etc. Empty string when Open States recorded none, which covers 28% of sessions — 13 jurisdictions carry no classification on any session at all.

end_date.description: Session end date. Empty string when Open States recorded no value; an absent endpoint means unknown, not ongoing.

identifier.description: Session identifier — use as session= in bill searches.

start_date.description: Session start date. Empty string when Open States recorded no value; an absent endpoint means unknown, not ongoing.

organizations.description: Legislative chambers and executive bodies when include=organizations is requested.

title: Get Jurisdiction
